svg.aria-label: decode-bms drawn as a bench instrument: a hopper of punched cards, the widget JSON BookMyShow's API sends (flexbox, scroll, carousel, ad), feeds a card reader one card at a time. The reader drives a phone on a stand that builds the BookMyShow home row by row in its mobile layout: red header, a scrolling poster row, an ad banner, a three-per-row grid and the bottom navigation. A movie ticket stub and a popcorn bucket sit on the bench.
